caption:
Your best tech's phone holds three weeks of customer texts.

When he quits, that history leaves with him. No record of the quote he promised or what you agreed to fix.

The Black Arrow platform ties every text to your business number and logs it on the contact's record. Anyone on your team can open the thread and pick up where it left off.

Run it on your own leads for 14 days. No card, cancel anytime.

rationale: Specific-scene cold-open hooks are winning B2B reel completion right now, and two-way texting tied to the CRM record has never anchored a Platform/Trial post, closing a real handoff risk every owner recognizes.
